name: smith rear delt row
description: A wide-grip row that pulls toward the upper chest to hit the back of the shoulders. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Set the smith bar at about knee height and stand close to it.
Hinge forward with a flat back and grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
Unrack the bar and let your arms hang straight.
Pull the bar toward your upper chest, leading with your elbows out to the sides.
Squeeze the backs of your shoulders, then lower slowly.
